lead.headline: Monangai is gone, the idle Vikings stay — and Love covers Allen's bye
lead.deck: A second skill player dropped in two days while a defence on bye sits on the bench. This week's lineup needs nothing.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. At 15:18 UTC Kyle Monangai, 80% rostered, was dropped to add Jordan Love. Love is a sound cover for Josh Allen's Week 7 bye, but the drop could have been the Vikings' defence, on bye and idle behind the Patriots since Wednesday; it was kept for the second day running. Monangai missed practice again on Thursday, so this week costs nothing, and reclaiming him would only reverse the morning's move. The lineup itself is in order: the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0. Jalen Coker and Isaiah Likely practised in full on Thursday; Kamara was limited again. The Jets were without Breece Hall and Adonai Mitchell at practice, good news for both your Patriots and Garrett Wilson. Bok-aneers reshuffled at midday and now project 109.5; ESPN has you at 59%.
